fields.summary: TC-MTA-003: Market Time Adjustment - First Trip Original Leg Delayed More Than 15 Minutes with Earlier Trip Start Generates LCO-D

content.text: Linked Story: Market Time Adjustment

Precondition: A crew member has an original first leg of the trip assigned in V0. The leg is delayed or moved by more than 15 minutes resulting in an earlier trip start time. isOriginal = TRUE initially.
TEST STEPS
Step
Action
Test Data
Expected Result
Set up a crew member with an original first leg of the trip on flight 123 HOU-DAL in V0
Flight 123 HOU-DAL, isOriginal=TRUE, leg position=First leg of trip, plannedDepTime=08:00, V0
Original first trip leg is set up successfully in V0
Apply a market time adjustment that moves the first leg by more than 15 minutes resulting in an earlier trip start time
Delay/move > 15 minutes, new trip start is earlier than original planned trip start, changeType=Market Time Adjustment
Market time adjustment is applied resulting in an earlier trip start time
Navigate to COA Search App and retrieve the COA record for the crew member
COA Search App - search by crew ID and trip
COA record is retrieved successfully
Verify the first leg is treated as Non-Original after more than 15-minute adjustment
isOriginal flag in COA record for the first leg
isOriginal = FALSE. Adjustment of more than 15 minutes changes original status to Non-Original.
Verify the trip start boundary is impacted and LCO-D is generated for this first leg
LCO field in COA record for the first leg
LCO-D is generated. Earlier trip start on a first original leg with more than 15-minute adjustment triggers LCO-D.
